intro.en: A CAN bus cable is the physical path between transceivers, connectors and nodes. The protocol name alone does not define conductor size, pair geometry, shielding, topology, termination or environmental construction.
intro.zh: CAN 总线电缆是收发器、连接器与节点之间的物理路径。仅有协议名称，不能定义导体规格、线对几何、屏蔽、拓扑、终端或环境结构。

knowledge.en: ISO 11898 separates the CAN data-link functions from the physical layer. Classical CAN, CAN FD and CAN XL are implementation options, while CANopen, DeviceNet and SAE J1939 add different higher-layer and application rules. The exact network must be identified before the cable assembly is released.
knowledge.zh: ISO 11898 将 CAN 数据链路功能与物理层分开。Classical CAN、CAN FD 与 CAN XL 是不同实现选项，CANopen、DeviceNet 和 SAE J1939 则增加各自的高层协议与应用规则。放行电缆组件前必须识别准确网络。

subtitle.en: Engineer the entire differential path, not just CAN_H and CAN_L
subtitle.zh: 设计完整差分路径，而不只是连接 CAN_H 与 CAN_L

lead.en: Define protocol profile, physical layer, topology, termination, pair construction, shield path, connector system and network evidence as one controlled assembly.
lead.zh: 把协议配置、物理层、拓扑、终端、线对结构、屏蔽路径、连接器系统与网络证据作为一个受控组件定义。

title.en: Start with the exact CAN network
title.zh: 先识别准确的 CAN 网络

copy.en: A request for a CAN cable may mean Classical CAN, CAN FD, CAN XL, CANopen, DeviceNet, SAE J1939 or an equipment-specific implementation. These names are not interchangeable. Record the controller, transceiver or device family, nominal and data-phase bit rates, network profile, node count and existing connector or harness architecture before selecting cable. A familiar twisted pair cannot establish compatibility by itself.
copy.zh: 客户所说的 CAN 电缆，可能对应 Classical CAN、CAN FD、CAN XL、CANopen、DeviceNet、SAE J1939 或设备专用实现，这些名称不能互换。选线前应记录控制器、收发器或设备系列、标称与数据阶段速率、网络配置、节点数量以及现有接口或线束架构。熟悉的双绞线外观本身不能证明兼容。

title.zh: 区分协议、收发器与实体布线

copy.en: CAN communication spans several engineering layers. The application determines message meaning; the controller and transceiver implement communication and electrical behavior; the cable assembly provides the physical differential path. A wiring supplier can preserve pair geometry, pinout, shield and termination intent, but cannot certify an ECU, software stack or complete vehicle network merely by delivering a cable.
copy.zh: CAN 通信跨越多个工程层级：应用决定报文含义，控制器与收发器实现通信及电气行为，电缆组件提供实体差分路径。线缆供应商可以保持线对几何、针脚、屏蔽与终端设计，但不能仅凭交付一条电缆就认证 ECU、软件栈或完整车辆网络。

title.en: Control the CAN_H and CAN_L pair as one structure
title.zh: 把 CAN_H 与 CAN_L 作为一个结构控制

copy.en: Conductor resistance, insulation material, twist lay, pair balance, capacitance, characteristic impedance and propagation behavior interact. The exact cable specification sets acceptable values; a generic 120-ohm label is not enough. At connectors and splices, limit untwist and abrupt geometry changes, and keep the return and reference conductors defined. Power cores in a hybrid CAN harness are sized separately for load, voltage drop and protection.
copy.zh: 导体电阻、绝缘材料、绞距、线对平衡、电容、特性阻抗与传播特性相互影响，准确线缆规范应规定允许值，单写“120 Ω”并不足够。接口与接续点需限制解绞长度和突变结构，同时明确回流与参考导体。复合 CAN 线束中的电源芯线应按负载、压降与保护单独计算。

title.en: Topology, bus length and stubs form one signal path
title.zh: 拓扑、总线长度与支线共同形成信号路径

copy.en: High-speed CAN is normally arranged as a line with nodes connected by controlled stubs rather than an arbitrary star. Main-bus length, drop length, node spacing, bit rate, cable propagation and transceiver timing must be reviewed together. Junction blocks and Y branches are not electrically neutral just because continuity is correct. The released drawing should show both the physical route and the logical network position of every branch.
copy.zh: 高速 CAN 通常采用线型主干并以受控支线连接节点，而不是任意星形结构。主干长度、支线长度、节点间距、速率、线缆传播与收发器时序必须共同审核。分线盒与 Y 型分支即使导通正确，也并非电气上完全透明。放行图纸应同时显示每个分支的物理路径与逻辑网络位置。

title.en: Define who owns each termination resistor
title.zh: 明确每个终端电阻由谁提供

copy.en: For the common high-speed line topology, the two ends are typically terminated with 120-ohm resistors to suppress reflections. The project must still define whether termination is inside an ECU, inside a connector, supplied as a removable plug or made switchable for service. Do not add a resistor to every branch. Measure the completed network with power removed only when the equipment procedure permits, and interpret the result from the actual topology.
copy.zh: 在常见高速线型拓扑中，两端通常使用 120 Ω 电阻抑制反射。但项目仍需说明终端是在 ECU 内、连接器内、作为可拆插头提供，还是为了维修而可切换。不能给每条支线都添加电阻。只有设备程序允许时，才可在断电状态测量完整网络，并结合真实拓扑解释结果。

title.en: Shielding is a grounding decision, not decoration
title.zh: 屏蔽是接地决策，不是装饰层

copy.en: Unshielded, foil-shielded, braided and hybrid CAN cables address different electromagnetic and mechanical conditions. Define shield coverage, drain wire, connector backshell transition, chassis bonding point and isolated end according to the system EMC design. A long pigtail can undermine high-frequency bonding, while an unintended multi-point path can create other problems. Keep noisy motor, inverter and solenoid routes separated where the installation allows.
copy.zh: 非屏蔽、铝箔屏蔽、编织屏蔽与复合 CAN 电缆分别应对不同电磁和机械条件。应根据系统 EMC 设计定义屏蔽覆盖、排流线、连接器尾罩过渡、机壳搭接点与隔离端。过长尾线会削弱高频搭接，意外多点路径也可能引入其他问题；安装条件允许时，应与电机、变频器和电磁阀等噪声路线保持分隔。

title.en: M12, DE-9, Deutsch and OBD shells do not define the pinout
title.zh: M12、DE-9、Deutsch 与 OBD 外壳不能定义针脚

copy.en: Industrial CAN assemblies may use M12, DE-9, circular or pluggable terminal connectors; vehicle networks may use Deutsch, OBD, sealed ECU connectors or customer-specific housings. Record plug or receptacle, coding, key, cavity map, terminal series, seals, backshell, exit direction and mating component. A connector that physically mates may still carry a different bus, power feed or proprietary pin assignment.
copy.zh: 工业 CAN 组件可能使用 M12、DE-9、圆形或插拔端子连接器；车辆网络可能使用 Deutsch、OBD、密封 ECU 接口或客户专用壳体。应记录插头或插座、编码、防错、孔位图、端子系列、密封件、尾罩、出线方向与对插件。能够机械插合的接口，仍可能承载不同总线、电源或专用针脚。

title.en: Match assembly tests to network risk
title.zh: 让组件测试匹配网络风险

copy.en: Production checks can include continuity, pin mapping, conductor and shield resistance, termination value, dimensions, labels, terminal retention and visual workmanship. Network validation may additionally require waveform, common-mode voltage, edge quality, error counters, bit-rate switching or functional communication checks with defined fixtures and node conditions. SAE J1939 compliance evidence applies to the ECU and network scope being tested; it is not created by a generic cable continuity report.
copy.zh: 生产检查可包括导通、针脚映射、导体与屏蔽电阻、终端阻值、尺寸、标签、端子保持与外观工艺。网络验证还可能需要按规定夹具和节点状态检查波形、共模电压、边沿质量、错误计数、速率切换或功能通信。SAE J1939 符合性证据对应被测 ECU 与网络范围，不能由一份通用电缆导通报告替代。

inputs.en: Exact CAN profile, device models, transceiver and nominal/data bit rates
inputs.zh: 准确 CAN 配置、设备型号、收发器与标称/数据速率

inputs.en: Network topology, node count, bus length, every stub and termination location
inputs.zh: 网络拓扑、节点数、主干长度、每条支线与终端位置

inputs.en: Cable construction, conductor size, impedance and shielding requirements
inputs.zh: 线缆结构、导体规格、阻抗与屏蔽要求

inputs.en: Connector part numbers, mating faces, cavity map, seals and exit directions
inputs.zh: 连接器料号、插合面、孔位图、密封件与出线方向

inputs.en: Temperature, fluids, abrasion, flex, vibration and installation zones
inputs.zh: 温度、液体、磨损、弯折、振动与安装区域

inputs.en: Drawing, sample, quantities and required assembly or network validation
inputs.zh: 图纸、样品、数量与所需组件或网络验证

q.zh: 所有 CAN 电缆都是 120 Ω 吗？

a.en: No universal assumption should be made. The exact physical-layer and cable specification defines nominal impedance and tolerances for the intended network.
a.zh: 不能作统一假设。预期网络的准确物理层与线缆规范会定义标称阻抗及公差。

q.en: Can CAN FD use an existing Classical CAN harness?
q.zh: CAN FD 可以直接使用现有 Classical CAN 线束吗？

a.en: Possibly, but only after the cable, topology, stubs, transceivers, connectors and required data-phase rate are reviewed together.
a.zh: 有可能，但必须共同审核线缆、拓扑、支线、收发器、连接器与所需数据阶段速率。

q.en: Does a DE-9 or M12 connector prove CAN compatibility?
q.zh: DE-9 或 M12 接口能证明 CAN 兼容吗？

a.en: No. Confirm coding, pin assignment, shield, power, termination and mating equipment from the project documentation.
a.zh: 不能。必须从项目资料确认编码、针脚、屏蔽、供电、终端与对接设备。

q.en: What evidence should accompany a custom CAN assembly?
q.zh: 定制 CAN 组件应附带哪些证据？

a.en: Use a controlled drawing and BOM, material traceability, process and dimensional records, assembly electrical results and any separately agreed network-level validation.
a.zh: 应包含受控图纸与 BOM、物料追溯、工艺和尺寸记录、组件电气结果，以及另行约定的网络级验证。
